# ResumeLink (resumelink.cc)

> ResumeLink is an AI resume builder that turns a PDF resume into an interactive online career profile with an ATS score, a shareable link and a QR code in about 10 seconds. It works in 50+ languages, free to start with no signup. It also publishes resume guides for 190+ emerging AI-era roles and honest comparisons with other resume builders.

## Product
- [Home](https://resumelink.cc/): AI resume builder — upload a PDF, get an interactive profile, ATS score, link and QR code
- [Pricing](https://resumelink.cc/pricing): free plan and paid upgrades
- [For business](https://resumelink.cc/business): white-label AI resume profiles for agencies, universities and platforms
- [About](https://resumelink.cc/about)
